_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

quests.t: Kill 10 Kul Tiras Sailors, 8 Kul Tiras Marines and Lieutenant Benedict and return to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.

o.t: Attack Plan: Valley of Trials destroyed

quests.t: Lar Prowltusk outside of Sen'jin Village wants you to destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Kolkar Crag.
Get 10 Scorpid Worker Tails for Gornek in the Den.
Kill Sarkoth and bring his claw back to Hana'zua.
Furl Scornbrow in the Razor Hill watchtower wants 8 Canvas Scraps.
Kill 12 Vile Familiars. Return to Zureetha Fargaze outside the Den.
Bring the Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze, outside The Den.
Bring the news of Hana'zua's plight to Gornek at the Den.
Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
Bring Fizzle's Claw to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
Retrieve Minshina's skull from the circle of power on the Echo Isles. Bring it to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
Find Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar and get the Venomtail Antidote. Then bring the antidote to Rhinag near the northwestern border of Durotar.
Bring 4 Venomtail Poison Sacs to Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar.
Bring 3 Taillasher Eggs to Cook Torka in Razor Hill.
Bring a sign of Kron's fate to Misha Tor'kren at the farmstead northwest of Razor Hill.
Bring 4 Durotar Tiger Furs to Vel'rin Fang in Sen'jin Village.
Bring 4 Intact Makrura Eyes and 8 vials of Crawler Mucus to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
Speak with Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
Gar'Thok of Razor Hill wants you to retrieve 3 Gnomish Tools from the wreckage off the coast.
Defeat Zalazane. Kill 8 Voodoo Trolls and 8 Hexed Trolls. Bring Zalazane's Head to Gadrin.
Gather Searing Collars from the cultists in Skull Rock. Bring them to Margoz at his camp.
Speak with Margoz.
Bring an Example Collar to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.
Deliver Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Nazgrel in Thrall's chamber in Orgrimmar.
Retrieve 5 Sacks of Supplies and return them to Rezlak near Orgrimmar.
Kill 12 Dustwind Savages and 8 Dustwind Storm Witches for Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
Kill 4 Razormane Quilboars, 4 Razormane Scouts, 4 Razormane Dustrunners and 4 Razormane Battleguards for Gar'Thok at Razor Hill.
Follow the western road from Razor Hill to the Barrens over a bridge. Stop at the orc outpost across the bridge. Give Kargal Battlescar at the Barrens outpost your recruitment letter.
Follow the western road from Kargal's Far Watch Outpost. At the T intersection, turn left and follow the road south. Find Sergra Darkthorn at the crossing of roads within the Crossroads.
Collect 7 Plainstrider Beaks and return them to Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
Of the Razormane tribe, kill 8 Water Seekers, 8 Thornweavers and 3 Hunters, and then return to Thork in the Crossroads.
Bring 6 Vile Familiar Heads to Ruzan.
Bring the Secure Crate to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
Bring 5 Singed Scales to Uzzek at Far Watch Post in the Barrens.
Speak with Zureetha Fargaze.
Retrieve the Tablet of Verga for Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
Speak with Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
Bring the Forged Steel Bars to Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
Using the Glyphs of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Glyphs of Summoning to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
Speak with Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
Bring 2 Felstalker Hooves to Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials.
Find Spirit Rock and drink the Earth Sapta.
Bring the Rough Quartz to Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials.
Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.
Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Telf Joolam in Durotar.
Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Telf Joolam in Durotar.
Speak with Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
Speak with Un'thuwa.
Destroy 4 Ju-Ju Heaps, then return to Un'thuwa in Sen'jin Village.
Bring Ukor's Burden to Innkeeper Grosk in Razor Hill.
Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.
Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.
Use the Foreman's Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the Foreman's Blackjack to Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.
Find Grunt Kor'ja and heal her wounds using Lesser Heal (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to Tai'jin at Razor Hill.
Speak to Tai'jin in Durotar.
Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
Take the Lieutenant's Insignia to Neeru Fireblade and speak to him. Gauge if he believes you are a member of the Burning Blade and then return to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Dire Mottled Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar in Razor Hill.
Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.
Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.
Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.
Speak with Ormak Grimshot in Orgrimmar.
Use the Taming Rod to tame an Armored Scorpid. Practice your skills, then return to Thotar at Razor Hill.
Use the Taming Rod to tame a Surf Crawler. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar at Razor Hill.
Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.
Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.
Bring Gryshka's Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.
Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.
Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.
Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Orgrimmar and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.
Speak with Snang in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Sit near Brakk's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.
Bring the journal to Brakk near Razor Hill.
Speak with Cook Torka in Razor Hill to learn to become a cook.
Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
Ug'thok in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Weathered Spines from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 5 Rough Grinding Stones.
Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.
Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
Bring 5 Charged Thunder Lizard Organs to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
Speak with Whuut in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

Speak with Lau'Tiki near Sen'jin Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Jandi in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Karolek in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Krunn in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Speak with Thuwd in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
Find signs of what attacked Heglan Shadeeye.
Collect 9 Naga Spinefins.
Kill the sea giant along Durotar's north coast and bring back proof of your accomplishment.

o.t: Escort Pal'juh out of Kolkar Crag.
